Lava Springs#001.src: Oh, good, good! I bet'cha you're a {p} soldier, aren't ya? Listen up, soldier! I've got a task here that 'ye can help out with.
Lava Springs#001.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#002.src: Ya see that lava spring right there? It just went and popped up out of nowhere! The brass is real concerned about it, mhm?
Lava Springs#002.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#003.src: They've been yappin' about it bein' related to the Corruption, and 'ye can bet that that means trouble. BAD trouble.
Lava Springs#003.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#004.src: Now, this here Savannah has always had some Corruption lurkin' about, but not to the point where it can do this! It won't be safe around here if we don't do somethin' about it!
Lava Springs#004.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#005.src: Anyways, high command ain't gonna provide support for this until they know there's actual Corruption, so we've gotta find some evidence around the springs, understand?
Lava Springs#005.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#006.src: Take a look around the springs, soldier! Find me some damn evidence around here! [{~} Pieces of Evidence] should be enough! Now, get movin'!
Lava Springs#006.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#007.src: Look for three pieces of corrupted evidence around the Lava Spring at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Lava Springs#008.src: Go back to Colonel Gailard at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Lava Springs#009.src: Alright, good! Ya found some evidence, let me take a look at that!
Lava Springs#009.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#010.src: Oh... This is bad... very, VERY bad...
Lava Springs#010.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#011.src: This here is some physical corruption. If it's gettin' onto the surface, then 'ye can bet one of those weeds is spreadin' underground, right beneath the springs...
Lava Springs#011.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#012.src: If ya could get underneath the spring, 'ye could probably sever whatever damn root is causing this, but... the heat would be sure to fry your skin off...
Lava Springs#012.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#013.src: Wait... I've got an idea... Alright, listen up soldier! There's a lil' town North of here called {p}, yeah? There's a healer person there that can help us out.
Lava Springs#013.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#014.src: They're holed up inside of some important well in the center of town. There's a password ya need to hop into that place, though...
Lava Springs#014.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#015.src: Don't have much to go on, but I'm pretty damn sure the password is Bob, or something. After the hero himself.
Lava Springs#015.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#016.src: Right, ye're headin' there to find a potion that can keep ya weak little hide safe from the heat, understand? Here, let me write down the location in that book of yours.
Lava Springs#016.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#017.src: Talk to Gregor outside the {p} well at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Lava Springs#018.src: Hey, hey hey hey! Darling, what do you think you're doing? You can't just waltz in here without telling me the password!
Lava Springs#018.speaker: Gregor

Lava Springs#019.src: Hmm... Your face... confidence... it gleans with confidence... yet... you still haven't spoken to me since you arrived...
Lava Springs#019.speaker: Gregor

Lava Springs#020.src: Could it be... you know that the password is penguin eggs, but you're just too shy to talk? Yeah... yeah, that's gotta be it!
Lava Springs#020.speaker: Gregor

Lava Springs#021.src: You've convinced me, little mute darling... You can enter the well. Go on, now!
Lava Springs#021.speaker: Gregor

Lava Springs#022.src: Enter the {p} well and talk to the healer at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Lava Springs#023.src: G'day to you, friend. How can I help you?
Lava Springs#023.speaker: Nami The Healer

Lava Springs#024.src: Hm? The Colonel sent you? what for?
Lava Springs#024.speaker: Nami The Healer

Lava Springs#025.src: ...Corrupted... lava springs...? You realize how ridiculous that sounds, yeah? Well, I completely believe you.
Lava Springs#025.speaker: Nami The Healer

Lava Springs#026.src: Right, you said lava, sooo... You need a heat resistance potion, yes?
Lava Springs#026.speaker: Nami The Healer

Lava Springs#027.src: Welp, you're in luck, kinda... I have a potion that can resist the heat of lava, but the brew will not let you swim in lava.
Lava Springs#027.speaker: Nami The Healer

Lava Springs#028.src: Oh that works, you just need to enter a borehole that goes through the lava? Perfect
Lava Springs#028.speaker: Nami The Healer

Lava Springs#029.src: Anyways, if you ever need any more special brews, my assistant will be happy to sell some at a very affordable price.
Lava Springs#029.speaker: Nami The Healer

Lava Springs#030.src: Now, you have somewhere to be, right? Right. Go and report to the Colonel, soldier. Tell him I said hi, by the way.
Lava Springs#030.speaker: Nami The Healer

Lava Springs#031.src: Report back to Colonel Gailard at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Lava Springs#032.src: Report! Ya got the potion yet, soldier? Good, drink it if ya haven't already!
Lava Springs#032.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#033.src: Right, that's what I like to hear! Now, LOOK TO THE LEFT SOLDIER! There is a borehole out there we dug to try and hit the source of this weed.
Lava Springs#033.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#034.src: We found a pretty damn hot cave lying underneath the surface! If ya jumped into the borehole, 'ye could probably find the source of the Corruption and stop it.
Lava Springs#034.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#035.src: Now, the roots and spikes of Corruption are very sturdy, but we ain't never seen something like lava burstin' out of the ground.
Lava Springs#035.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#036.src: Had a small chat with the brass, earlier. They got a hunch that there's a heart to the Corruption that's pumpin' out all the lava!
Lava Springs#036.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#037.src: That's gotta be our ticket, yeah? If 'ye destroy that, ya should be able to stop the spread of the lava! Now, get movin'! Head into the borehole, soldier!
Lava Springs#037.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#038.src: Drink the Potion of Obsidian Skin, then enter the lava spring through the borehole at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] and look for a corrupted heart

Lava Springs#039.src: Tell Colonel Gailard at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] that you destroyed the heart

Lava Springs#040.src: Hah! I knew ya'd give me results! Ye're pretty damn reliable, soldier! Here, take this for your trouble!
Lava Springs#040.speaker: Colonel Gailard
